comment: Closed FYs that are frozen. The freeze is stronger than REGISTER_SYNC_PAUSE: (1) the scheduler skips frozen FYs entirely, (2) ensureRegisterSynced treats them as permanently done, (3) force-resync rejects them with HTTP 423 unless ?unfreeze=true&reason=<text> is supplied. Row and amount anchors are asserted on every startup; a mismatch means something wrote to an immutable year. amountRupees=0 means the Sheets-sourced total has not yet been confirmed — the amount assertion is skipped until it is filled in.
